analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the seroprotection rates and associated factors for hepatitis B vaccine-induced immunity among hill tribe and stateless children in northern Thailand. A case–control study design was used, comparing fully and partially vaccinated children. Blood samples were collected for biomarker detection, and logistic regression was employed to identify risk factors for the absence of anti-HBs. The overall prevalence of anti-HBs was 59.3%, with similar rates observed in both fully and partially vaccinated groups. The results suggest that the immune response rate remains undesirable, highlighting the need for improved monitoring and assessment programs. The study's limitations include reliance on abstract-only data, which may not fully represent the clinical context. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study design and data scope.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在确定泰国北部完全和部分接种疫苗的山地部落和五岁无国籍儿童之间血清保护的差异,以及自 1992 年开始实施 疫苗 以来这些儿童缺乏抗 HBs 的相关因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项病例对照研究,以收集居住在清莱府 Mae Fah Luang 区村庄的山地部落和无国籍人士的信息。未事先免疫、延迟免疫或不完全乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的儿童被纳入其中。
elements_zh.methods: 发放调查问卷,采集血样3 mL,用于乙型肝炎生物标志物的定性和定量检测。应用逻辑回归来检测与抗-HBs缺失相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 抗-HBs总体患病率为59.3%;完全型疫苗接种患儿(其中2例抗-HBc阳性)中抗-HBs检出率为55.3%,不完全型疫苗接种患儿中检出率为55.3%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,山区部落和无国籍儿童中乙型肝炎 疫苗 引起的 免疫应答 率仍然不理想,这表明需要有效的评估计划来监测这一问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,监测易感人群中 疫苗 诱导的免疫力对于改进 疫苗接种 策略并确保充分预防乙型肝炎具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究包括 188 例病例和 188 名对照组,其中 54% 为男性,54.3% 属于阿卡组,但证据仅限于抽象数据,可能无法捕捉详细的临床或流行病学细微差别。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在确定泰国北部完全和部分接种疫苗的山地部落和五岁无国籍儿童之间血清保护的差异,以及自 1992 年开始实施 疫苗 以来这些儿童缺乏抗 HBs 的相关因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项病例对照研究,以收集居住在清莱府 Mae Fah Luang 区村庄的山地部落和无国籍人士的信息。未事先免疫、延迟免疫或不完全乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的儿童被纳入其中。
analysis_zh.methods: 发放调查问卷,采集血样3 mL,用于乙型肝炎生物标志物的定性和定量检测。应用逻辑回归来检测与抗-HBs缺失相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 抗-HBs总体患病率为59.3%;完全型疫苗接种患儿(其中2例抗-HBc阳性)中抗-HBs检出率为55.3%,不完全型疫苗接种患儿中检出率为55.3%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,山区部落和无国籍儿童中乙型肝炎 疫苗 引起的 免疫应答 率仍然不理想,这表明需要有效的评估计划来监测这一问题。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,监测易感人群中 疫苗 诱导的免疫力对于改进 疫苗接种 策略并确保充分预防乙型肝炎具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究包括 188 例病例和 188 名对照组,其中 54% 为男性,54.3% 属于阿卡组,但证据仅限于抽象数据,可能无法捕捉详细的临床或流行病学细微差别。

full_text: Abstract Background The N-terminal domain (NTD) of hepatitis B virus (HBV) core region (C region) plays crucial role in its life cycle, while the functional implications of related mutations remain unclear. This study aimed to characterize the emergence of mutations in the HBV C region and investigate the impact of high-frequency C region mutations on HBV life cycle. Methods Three hundred twenty-six HBV samples were collected from 32 blood establishments across 14 provinces in China and subsequently subjected to comprehensive serological analysis, mutational analysis, and assessment of major histocompatibility complex (MHC)-restricted site distribution in C region. The impact of high-frequency C region mutations on HBV replication and expression was further investigated through in vitro experiments. full_text: Abstract Glecaprevir/Pibrentasvir (GLE/PIB) is an interferon-free direct-acting antiviral (DAA) regimen indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. However, data on the pharmacokinetics and stability of crushed or split tablets are lacking, complicating administration in patients with dysphagia requiring percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG). Additionally, no published studies have evaluated the safety and efficacy of DAAs in combination with Risdiplam, the first oral therapy developed for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA). We report a case of a 14-year-old dysphagic patient with SMA, receiving Risdiplam, who was successfully treated with crushed GLE/PIB administrated via PEG. The patient achieved a sustained virologic response (SVR) 12 weeks after the end of therapy, without significant adverse effects, and no drug interactions were observed during the course of treatment. title: Expanding Hepatitis C Testing and Treatment in U.S. Prisons and Jails
abstract: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) is highly prevalent in U.S. prisons and jails, where infection rates are 10–20 times greater than national levels and where more than 30% of people with HCV will spend time in any given year. Rates are especially high among people who inject drugs, who are also likely to move between correctional settings and the community. Addressing HCV behind bars could therefore significantly diminish virus transmission both inside and outside of confinement. Safe and effective HCV treatment is now possible with direct-acting antivirals (DAAs), but access remains limited in carceral facilities, which often provide treatment only for people with advanced disease and impose non-medical barriers to care. These failures have been challenged in civil rights litigation. Drawing lessons from the resulting settlements, this chapter provides template policies for scaling up HCV testing, evaluating and monitoring disease, universalizing access to DAA medication, and supporting successful treatment outcomes.

full_text_sections.abstract: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) is highly prevalent in U.S. prisons and jails, where infection rates are 10–20 times greater than national levels and where more than 30% of people with HCV will spend time in any given year. Rates are especially high among people who inject drugs, who are also likely to move between correctional settings and the community. Addressing HCV behind bars could therefore significantly diminish virus transmission both inside and outside of confinement. Safe and effective HCV treatment is now possible with direct-acting antivirals (DAAs), but access remains limited in carceral facilities, which often provide treatment only for people with advanced disease and impose non-medical barriers to care. These failures have been challenged in civil rights litigation. Drawing lessons from the resulting settlements, this chapter provides template policies for scaling up HCV testing, evaluating and monitoring disease, universalizing access to DAA medication, and supporting successful treatment outcomes.

full_text: Abstract This study assessed fungal contamination, multi-mycotoxin occurrence and associated health risks in maize consumed in Niger State, Nigeria. A total of 240 individual maize samples were collected across four microclimatic zones and pooled into 32 composite samples stratified by zone, source and maize type to obtain representative contamination profiles for screening-level assessment. Fungal isolation was performed using dilution plating, while mycotoxins were quantified by HPLC (aflatoxins, deoxynivalenol (DON), nivalenol (NIV), and cyclopiazonic acid (CPA)) and ELISA (total fumonisins (FB1, FB2 and FB3), ochratoxin A (OTA), and zearalenone (ZEN)). Aspergillus species, particularly A. flavus and A. parasiticus, predominated, followed by Fusarium and Penicillium. Aflatoxins were detected in all composites (0.03–683 μg/kg). AFB1 exceeded European Union (EU) limits in 75% of composites, while total aflatoxins exceeded limits in 72%. Total fumonisins exceeded EU limits in 72% of composites and OTA in 56%, whereas CPA, DON, NIV and ZEN occurred less frequently. Co-contamination was common, with up to five toxins detected simultaneously. Dietary exposure estimates indicated the highest exposure for total fumonisins (up to 9125.8 ng/kg bw/day), exceeding the corresponding tolerable daily intake. Margins of exposure (MOE) for aflatoxins and OTA were < 10,000 across demographic groups. Using JECFA cancer potency factors and hepatitis B virus prevalence scenarios (13.6% and 8.1%), estimated aflatoxin-attributable hepatocellular carcinoma incidence ranged from 4.92 to 7.26 cases per 100,000 population per year for AFB1 and up to 15.39 cases for total aflatoxins. These findings highlight the need for improved pre- and post-harvest control measures.
